# InBharat AI

> InBharat.ai builds private agentic AI and practical tools for Bharat.
> Its flagship is PAI (pronounced “Pi”), one personal private AI agent,
> implemented through UnoOne Power for Windows and UnoOne Mobile for Android.
> The InBharat AI web console is a separate browser product, not UnoOne.

Founded by Reeturaj Goswami. Operated by Uni Guru Technologies LLP.

## Readiness and data boundaries — content reviewed 16 November 2026

- UnoOne Power: Windows development builds; scoped internal verification on one
  engineering test environment, not broad release qualification.
- UnoOne Mobile: Android alpha. Current planner activation, device migrations and
  hardware coverage remain under validation. Earlier device-run results are not
  proof of every current build; see the per-capability evidence on its page.
- No public UnoOne installer is offered. Contact the team for pilot discussions;
  no public UnoOne price or free offer is established here.
- Sync: pairing protocol designed and unit-tested. No physical phone–desktop
  round trip is qualified, manual or automatic. Each device has its own encrypted
  local store, not one automatically shared physical vault.
- Personal memory is local and core inference is local. Optional searches, mail
  connectors, website navigation, confirmed form submissions and uploads can
  send requests, queries, form fields or selected files to external services.
  Website sessions have normal authentication traffic; the agent does not type
  passwords. Local storage is not a claim that all network traffic stays local.
- Mobile blocks payment, OTP, password-entry and auto-send agent actions.
  Confirmation does not unlock them; the person completes sensitive steps
  manually outside the agent. Messaging is drafts-never-sends.
- Language selection includes English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil,
  Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia and Assamese. Translations are partial with
  English fallback. UI, text-model, speech-recognition and speech-synthesis
  coverage are separate; a public product/language/modality matrix is pending.
- SILT is research, not demonstrated AGI or autonomous self-improvement.
  Historical Pocket AI removable-drive research is not the current consumer
  product. Recorded patent applications do not certify runtime capabilities or
  establish coverage of all newer UnoOne features.

## Recognitions and programmes

The site retains owner-supplied recognition and participation records. These are
not all awards or educational credentials, and do not endorse or certify products.
Public verification links are included where available; absent links do not imply
revocation. Current issuer records and permission to publish them remain owner-held.

- DPIIT startup recognition in AI & ML: held by Uni Guru Technologies LLP.
- Stanford Seed Spark 2026: founder selection.
- OpenAI Partner Network: organisation membership, onboarding recorded in 2026.
- Google Cloud Gen AI Academy APAC Cohort 3: founder participation.
- Hyperagent Founding 500: founding membership.
- Sarvam Startup Program: organisation participation.
- Google Developer Program: programme participation, badges and memberships.
- Anthropic Education and Microsoft Education: recorded course/module completions.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.inbharat.ai/): PAI, UnoOne and the fifteen-product directory.
- [PAI](https://www.inbharat.ai/private-ai): definition, permissions and data flows.
- [UnoOne](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone): Power and Mobile development ecosystem.
- [Power](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone/power): Windows capability/validation scope.
- [Mobile](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone/mobile): Android alpha and action boundaries.
- [Sync](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone/sync): unit-tested design, unqualified round trip.
- [Enterprise AI](https://www.inbharat.ai/enterprise-ai): JAK Swarm/Shield components;
  scoped engagement, no certified compliance or verified institutional deployments.
- [Technology](https://www.inbharat.ai/technology): implementation, research and history.
- [Web console](https://www.inbharat.ai/app): separate browser search/chat product.
- [About](https://www.inbharat.ai/about): company and product taxonomy.
- [Learn AI](https://www.inbharat.ai/learn-ai-with-reeturaj): educational articles,
  including dated corrections and explicitly historical research proposals.
- [Contact](https://www.inbharat.ai/contact): pilots, support and research enquiries.
- [Privacy](https://www.inbharat.ai/privacy): website/console privacy information;
  do not treat UnoOne local inference as a blanket policy for every product.

## Other product entry points

Listing a site or repository is not proof of live service health, clinical
validation, government use or availability of every described feature.

- [KathaKitaab](https://www.kathakitaab.com): stories and interactive learning.
- [JAK Swarm](https://jakswarm.com): agent workflows and orchestration.
- [JAK Shield](https://github.com/inbharatai/jak-shield): tool-use risk controls.
- [Sahayaak AI](https://github.com/inbharatai/sahaayak-ai-public): personal AI workspace.
- [UniAssist.ai](https://www.uniassist.ai): admissions guidance.
- [TestsPrep](https://testsprep.in): exam preparation.
- [UniBot](https://www.inbharat.ai/#chatbot): conversational support.
- [Sahayaak Seva](https://sahayaakseva.in): field-assistance project.
- [SwasthyaScore AI](https://swasthyascore-ai.vercel.app): health-screening project,
  not a diagnosis or validated substitute for clinical measurement.
- [Phoring](https://github.com/inbharatai/phoring): decision-intelligence simulations.
- [Agent Arcade](https://github.com/inbharatai/agent-arcade-gateway): observability.
- [SocialFlow](https://github.com/inbharatai/SocialFlow): social publishing automation;
  publishing and cloud generation transmit configured content externally.
- [OpenClawFix](https://openclawfix.pro): developer setup tooling.
